families.idea: Short c * N * p_adverse shares of the held stock, re-sized when the prediction market moves enough to beat fees

params.name: coverage
params.help: c: fraction of the position hedged at p = 1

params.name: band_shares
params.help: no-trade band in shares

params.name: sigma_k
params.help: trade only when |dp| >= k * EWMA sigma of dp (0 = off)

params.name: fee_ratio
params.help: trade only if benefit >= ratio * (fee + half-spread)

params.name: impact
params.help: expected fractional stock move if the adverse event resolves (from the impact model); prices the fee gate's benefit; 0 disables the fee gate

params.name: session
params.help: 1 = trade only in US equity regular hours (live bridges)

params.name: wash_guard
params.help: 1 = block re-shorting within 30 days of a loss cover (wash sale)

families.idea: When this venue's YES mid is rich (cheap) against the other venue by more than half-spread + fee + entry, buy NO (YES) here and exit when the gap closes; stop if the gap flips through the entry threshold

params.name: entry_gap
params.help: net edge (gap - half-spread - fee) to enter

params.name: exit_gap
params.help: exit once the gap on the entry side is <= this

params.name: size
params.help: contracts per entry (one clip, no pyramiding)

params.name: max_spread
params.help: skip entries when this venue's YES spread is wider

families.idea: Sell NO into bids that are rich against a fair value (other venue, EWMA, or option-implied), Kelly-sized, routed to the venue with the best all-in price, never showing more than a fraction of displayed size

params.name: edge
params.help: all-in NO bid minus fair NO needed to sell

params.name: kelly_cap
params.help: cap on the Kelly fraction of bankroll

params.name: fair_source
params.help: fair YES from 0 other venue, 1 EWMA of mid, 2 options

params.name: iceberg_frac
params.help: max fraction of displayed size per order

params.name: bankroll
params.help: $ at risk for Kelly sizing

params.name: max_notional
params.help: cap on short NO $ notional at the sale price (0 = off)

params.name: daily_loss
params.help: stop new sales after losing this many $ (marked at the YES mid) since the UTC day began (0 = off)

families.idea: While the stock market is closed, buy the adverse YES contract sized so a 1 pp PM move offsets the expected equity move (rate bp per pp); at the open unwind the PM leg and hand the hedge to the equity

params.name: coverage
params.help: c: fraction of the held shares covered by the PM and equity legs combined

params.name: rate_bp_per_pp
params.help: r: bp of equity move per pp of PM move (per-market estimate, else the pooled 7.52 from 380 closures)

params.name: rate_scale
params.help: multiplier on r (r_eff = r * scale)

params.name: band_contracts
params.help: no-trade band on the YES leg: trade only if |target - held| >= band contracts

params.name: max_notional
params.help: cap on YES contracts * YES price in $ (0 = off)

params.name: exp_move_pp
params.help: PM move (pp) expected over a closure; prices the fee gate's benefit; 0 disables the fee gate

params.name: handoff_equity
params.help: 1 = after unwinding the YES leg at the open, move the hedge into the equity at round(c * N * p)

params.name: equity_band
params.help: no-trade band in shares for the equity handoff leg
